reuse_rule: A clip may not be used again until 30 days after it was last used. Clips with the same group (same name apart from a trailing number) count as the same video.
match_rule: The phrase must be about what is visible in the clip. Pick the clips first (both sharing a tag), look at a frame of each, then write the phrase about the thing on screen.
